definitions.ask: Re-baseline test-cost budgets whose misses trace to suite growth rather than a named regression?
definitions.why: The suite grew from ~28k to ~62k tests since the budgets were set; a forever-red gate gets ignored

choices.label: Re-measure on a quiet host; reset stale budgets with headroom; fix only named regressions
Keep every committed budget and cut suite cost until it passes; may need a child epic
Drop the summary-level budgets from the gate and keep only the per-cause budgets

definitions.ask: Should the host relaunch the land agent of an epic whose children all closed while no land agent is live?
definitions.why: Nothing surfaces zombie epics today, and the land agent still verifies before closing anything

choices.label: Host relaunches the land agent of newly zombied epics; existing zombies are only reported
Host sends one inbox notification per new zombie epic and launches nothing
No live mechanism; ship only the report command for existing zombies
